shared_configuration: Actual SpongeDQN gamma0, replay4096, batch64, lr0.0005; same examples/order/costs and inference reserve. The only reward difference is raw net log return versus log advantage over unchanged holding.
coaching: Every action is explained by market PnL before/after delayed fill, paid costs, net return and matched advantage over hold. Worker validates accounting and maturity before actual updates. Past mentor comparisons accompany inference explanations; realized outcome components are never future decision inputs.
selection: No candidate selection: report both arms even if coached training loses
